snippet.title: Mushroom Hunter World - Announcement Trailer (PC)
snippet.description: Go to the forest to collect as many mushrooms as possible! Will you be able to fill your basket to the brim? Develop your attentiveness, collect a variety of mushrooms and compete for the title of the best mushroom picker.
